messages:
maria: Kicking off RC creation for candidate rc-2026-03-19. Cut from sha b7a1c3f. Change window request 02:00-04:00 UTC. Main changes: rate-limiter tweak, embed-service config update, model bump to redwood-llama-v2-7b-quant. Release notes PR: https://git.internal/r/1234
kevin: LGTM on code. Local smoke tests passed, no obvious regressions.
jon: Can we pin the model to a quant profile explicitly? Risk is KV cache invalidation on first warm. If we pin, include quick rollback route to previous model (v1.13).
liz: +1. Docs need a short note about expected p95 shift. I'll update docs after promotion.
deploy-bot: /create-rc candidate=rc-2026-03-19 sha=b7a1c3f initiator=@maria 
maria: Requesting explicit pin: prod:models/redwood-llama-v2@v2-quant. I'll include it in the promote command.
kevin: Suggest a KV warm step pre-rollout, otherwise first few requests will be slow.
sre-oncall: Agreed. We'll run kv-warm for 15m before shifting traffic. I'll babysit metrics.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: kv-warm start in 25m. Promotion window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rollout policy set: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m health waits.
maria: Rollback criteria: auto-rollback to sha=a3c9f00 if error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >800ms for 5m. Manual abort always allowed by Ops.
jon: Also gate on embed-service /healthz == 200 on canary nodes; if unhealthy abort.
liz: Release notes (draft): https://docs.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-19 — mention known prompt truncation edge case.
kevin: I approve sign-off. @sre-oncall will you own rollback execution if triggered?
sre-oncall: Oncall confirmed. I'll post a rollback checklist when kv-warm starts.
deploy-bot: /promote candidate=rc-2026-03-19 pin=prod:models/redwood-llama-v2@v2-quant window=02:00-04:00 rollout=[10,50,100] kv_warm=900s initiator=@maria
maria: Promotion initiated. Watching traces, logs, and cost dashboard. Alert channels: #incidents #eng-sre #deploys.
jon: Monitoring hooks: alert if error-rate delta >0.5% or 5xx spike + if p95 increases >200ms.
deploy-bot: Promotion step: canary -> live. Canaries reported healthy at 02:05 UTC. Next step scheduled 02:10 UTC.
liz: Observed a small uptick in token cost on canary due to quant path change; expected. Keeping an eye.
sre-oncall: If stable for 30m we'll finalize to 100%. I'll escalate immediately otherwise.
kevin: Rollback command for quick reference: ```
./scripts/rollback.sh --to-sha=a3c9f00 --reason="canary-fail"
```
maria: If we end up aborting, I'll own the postmortem. If not, I'll merge the release notes and tag authors.
deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% at 02:34 UTC. All health checks green, no auto-rollback triggered.
